name: The Last Drive-In with Joe Bob Briggs:  Joe Bob's Wicked Witchy Wingding
original_name: The Last Drive-In with Joe Bob Briggs:  Joe Bob's Wicked Witchy Wingding
overview: "Joe Bob's Wicked Witchy Wingding," a special Walpurgisnacht-themed double feature of The Last Drive-In with Joe Bob Briggs, becomes available on-demand on Shudder and AMC+ on Sunday, April 26, 2026. This special, which originally airs live on April 24, features the film Rawhead Rex and celebrates Joe Bob's favorite holiday.
